class TTLCache:
    def __init__(self, capacity: int, ttl: float):
        self.capacity = capacity
        self.ttl = ttl
        self._store = {}  # key -> (value, written_at); dict order = LRU order (front = least recent)

    def put(self, key, value, now: float) -> None:
        if self.capacity <= 0:
            return
        if key in self._store:
            # Update value, reset expiry clock, refresh recency.
            self._store.pop(key)
            self._store[key] = (value, now)
            return
        if len(self._store) >= self.capacity:
            # First purge every expired entry.
            expired = [k for k, (_, t) in self._store.items() if now - t >= self.ttl]
            for k in expired:
                del self._store[k]
            # Only if still at capacity, evict the least recently used live entry.
            if len(self._store) >= self.capacity:
                evict = next(iter(self._store))
                del self._store[evict]
        self._store[key] = (value, now)

    def get(self, key, now: float):
        if key not in self._store:
            return None
        value, t = self._store[key]
        if now - t >= self.ttl:
            # Expired: at exactly now - t == ttl it is expired. Remove it.
            del self._store[key]
            return None
        # Live: refresh recency only; expiry clock is untouched.
        self._store.pop(key)
        self._store[key] = (value, t)
        return value

class TTLCache:
    class _Node:
        __slots__ = ("key", "value", "time", "prev", "next")

        def __init__(self, key=None, value=None, time=0.0):
            self.key = key
            self.value = value
            self.time = time
            self.prev = None
            self.next = None

    def __init__(self, capacity, ttl):
        self.capacity = capacity
        self.ttl = ttl
        self._store = {}
        self._head = self._Node()
        self._tail = self._Node()
        self._head.next = self._tail
        self._tail.prev = self._head

    def _unlink(self, node):
        node.prev.next = node.next
        node.next.prev = node.prev
        node.prev = None
        node.next = None

    def _push_front(self, node):
        node.next = self._head.next
        node.prev = self._head
        self._head.next.prev = node
        self._head.next = node

    def _is_expired(self, node, now):
        return (now - node.time) >= self.ttl

    def _remove(self, key, node):
        self._unlink(node)
        del self._store[key]

    def put(self, key, value, now):
        node = self._store.get(key)
        if node is not None:
            node.value = value
            node.time = now
            self._unlink(node)
            self._push_front(node)
            return
        if self.capacity > 0 and len(self._store) >= self.capacity:
            expired_keys = [k for k, n in self._store.items() if self._is_expired(n, now)]
            for k in expired_keys:
                self._remove(k, self._store[k])
            if len(self._store) >= self.capacity:
                lru = self._tail.prev
                if lru is not self._tail:
                    self._remove(lru.key, lru)
        if self.capacity > 0:
            node = self._Node(key, value, now)
            self._push_front(node)
            self._store[key] = node

    def get(self, key, now):
        node = self._store.get(key)
        if node is None:
            return None
        if self._is_expired(node, now):
            self._remove(key, node)
            return None
        self._unlink(node)
        self._push_front(node)
        return node.value
